column1: # The exact set of files RepoLocator.EpheDir must contain for the conformance oracle to run
# against reproducible data. Read by EphemerisManifest and asserted by ConformanceRunner.Run
# before anything is dispatched.
# This is the declared "core set" .github/workflows/conformance.yml's sparse-checkout step
# fetches (~4.2 MB) -- see README.md's "Correctness oracle" section and CONTRIBUTING.md's
# "The upstream C is vendored at external/swisseph" for the sparse-checkout recipe that
# produces exactly this set from a fresh clone. Extra files are as much a problem as missing
# ones: a plain, non-sparse `git submodule update --init external/swisseph` pulls every era
# file (378 MB), and several iterations (suite 5 testcase 3 among them) only pass because a
# file this repo does not declare happens to be present -- generating a known-fail.tsv that
# looks right locally and is wrong for CI and every other contributor. One file per line, no
# path prefix (relative to ephe/), '#' starts a comment.
seas_12.se1
seas_18.se1
sefstars.txt
semo_12.se1
semo_18.se1
seorbel.txt
sepl_12.se1
sepl_18.se1
